title: Machine data as a dependent tuple
statement: For a binary-choice Turing machine code with $k$ work tapes and one more than its stated number of states, the associated dependent tuple records the pair of natural numbers $(k,	ext{number of states minus one})$, an initial state among the corresponding states, and the two transition functions specifying the machine's actions.
